# Repetition beats severity

`customer_support.heu.churn_signal_detection.repetition_beats_severity` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Repeat contact about the same underlying issue predicts departure better than any single severe one.


## The heuristic

**Repeat contact about the same underlying issue predicts departure better than any single severe one.**


_Why:_ Customers forgive events; they do not forgive a pattern. One outage is something that happened to us both. Returning again and again about the same thing is evidence the product does not work for them, and an apology does not change evidence.
